title: Private Mount Vernon Tour for up to 10 Guests
includes: George Washington’s Mansion: Tour the interior of Washington's historic home.
Hotel Pickup & Dropoff: Convenient hotel pickup and dropoff included in the tour.
Washington's Tomb: Visit the final resting place of George and Martha Washington.
Luxury Transportation: Comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle for travel up to 10 guests.
Farm & Livestock: Visit the working farm and see historic farming techniques.
Complimentary Bottled Water: Stay refreshed with complimentary water.
Admission Tickets: Complimentary entry tickets to Mount Vernon.
Private Expert Guide: Knowledgeable guide providing historical insights.
Gift Shop Stop: Time to explore the Mount Vernon gift shop for souvenirs.
Photo Opportunities: Capture iconic moments with the mansion and Potomac River.
Gardens & Grounds: Explore the beautiful gardens and grounds.
Slave Memorial & Cemetery: Reflect at the site honoring enslaved individuals.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a historical journey to Mount Vernon, the estate of George Washington. This captivating tour brings history, culture, and natural beauty together as you explore the mansion, gardens, and grounds that Washington personally designed, offering stunning views of the Potomac River.

Step back in time as you tour the preserved mansion, furnished with 18th-century period pieces. Learn about Washington's life, leadership, and impact on the United States from your knowledgeable guide. Visit the Slave Quarters and Memorial to gain a deeper understanding of the complexities of Mount Vernon's history.

For 4 guests or fewer, you’ll ride in a luxury SUV. For 5 to 10 guests, you’ll enjoy a comfortable ride in a Mercedes Sprinter van. This immersive experience provides a unique glimpse into the life of one of America's greatest figures.
